_comment: S47/S48 (ADR-145): the card rating — generated by pnpm rating:build from pnpm rating:run (analysis/runs, local). rating = prior(tier) + 0.5 × ½(presence′/σP + lift′/σL); see world/rating-build-cli.ts. presence and lift are raw win-rate differences; seen is the sample behind lift and castWhenDrawn. Post-S52 (v1.3, Chris 2026-10-05): each row also carries `limited` — the Limited score (rating-compute.ts computeLimitedRating: empirical Bayes on Limited games only, run.limited) — which every Limited path reads through limitedView; `rating` stays v1.1's and is the Constructed score. S53 (v1.4): the Limited score re-measured with three runs on v1.3's decks added (ADR-150's watch); the head-to-head held (draft 52.8%, Sealed 51.3% against v1.3). Post-S53 (Chris, 2026-10-03): Rage Cobra became {1}{R} 2/2; its Limited score is the card test's estimate (2.31 — `pnpm card-test`: +2.5 ± 0.4 over the old card, mapped by Gray Ogre and Boggart Brute's measured scores), its old card's sightings cleared, until the next Limited re-measure. Its Constructed `rating` is the old card's.
